Question 10
?

Find the domain of the function z=x−yx2+y2−4.

a
{(x,y)∈R2:x≠y,x2+y2≠4}
b
{(x,y)∈R2:x≥y,x2+y2>4}
c
The domain is the entire xy−plane
d
{(x,y)∈R2:x≥y,x2+y2≠4}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:x≠y,x2+y2>4}
